The '''Amar system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Airon sector/Legends|Airon sector]] in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] which contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Amar]].
